description: Pre-Ingestion Quality Gates, Facility-Level Partitioning, Provenance Standards, and Dataset Readiness Criteria.

facility_partition_strategy.rationale: Prevents catastrophic spatial data leakage caused by sharing warehouse geometry, floor texture, and lighting between splits.

partitions.usage: Candidate discovery training and parameter exploration.
Strictly quarantined for final generalization validation; zero exposure during development.

pre_ingestion_quality_gates.metric: CAN bus telemetry to video frame synchronization delta
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.rejection_action: Mark telemetry as UNVERIFIED; exclude from quantitative braking analysis.

pre_ingestion_quality_gates.metric: Ground plane homography and extrinsic reprojection error
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.rejection_action: Recalibrate camera extrinsic matrices before event logging.

pre_ingestion_quality_gates.metric: Defined 2D/3D polygons for primary and secondary zones
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.threshold: All zone vertices surveyed and verified in facility coordinates

pre_ingestion_quality_gates.metric: CAN signal continuity (speed, acceleration, brake switch)
Secondary zone interior depth visibility verification
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.threshold: Camera C line-of-sight confirmed OR LiDAR/UWB active and unoccluded
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.rejection_action: Reject event from backfire validation pool; route to INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVABILITY.

pre_ingestion_quality_gates.metric: PRE, INTERVENTION, and POST window completeness
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.threshold: T_pre >= 3.0s, T_interv >= 1.5s, T_post >= 4.0s without clip truncation

pre_ingestion_quality_gates.metric: Dual-blinded human review completion and cryptographic signoff
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.threshold: Both reviewer forms signed and consensus/adjudication recorded
pre_ingestion_quality_gates.rejection_action: Exclude event from validated ground-truth benchmark.

dataset_readiness_acceptance_criteria: DATASET_READINESS: 100% of candidate events pass pre-ingestion quality gates G_CAMERA_SYNC through G_EVENT_COMPLETENESS.
EVIDENCE_COMPLETENESS: Zero missing mandatory telemetry signals across evaluated event windows.
SENSOR_COVERAGE: All four camera views (A, B, C, D) present and optically calibrated.
ZONE_COVERAGE: Secondary zone interior depth is affirmatively observable in all candidate events.
TEMPORAL_COVERAGE: Unclipped observation throughout the dynamic post-intervention window.
GT_READINESS: Dual-blinded human adjudication protocol completed with Cohen's Kappa >= 0.80.

required_input_parameters_prior_to_numbe: Expected true backfire prevalence (p) in operational logistics facilities
Target statistical confidence level (1 - alpha, e.g., 95%)
Statistical power (1 - beta, e.g., 80% to 90%) for hypothesis testing between baseline and intervention configurations
statistical_sample_size_framework.policy_note: No arbitrary integer event count is fabricated; final sample size will be derived following pilot prevalence estimation.
